İnsanİş — A construction management system

Bridging the information gap between the office and the construction site.

01 / Overview

İnsanİş is construction management software that automates processes that usually stay undigitised. It gives managers, contractors and owners one hub for site work, staff and materials.

02 / The problem

Site data gets lost between the office and the field. Daily logs stay on paper, material use is reported by phone in the evening, and budget overruns only surface at month-end.

03 / Our approach

Sites, staff and material supply were consolidated into one dashboard. Daily logs, task assignment and hand-overs were digitised, and finance and progress were tied to real-time charts.

04 / The result

Managers see percentage progress, the budget overview and critical alerts on one screen. Digitising routine work lowers operating costs and speeds up decisions.
